## ⚠️ Before Opening This Pull Request

**This repository uses an issue-first workflow for content contributions.**

Content changes — new sections, rewritten explanations, restructured topics — are not accepted as pull requests. This protects the playbook's teaching voice, progressive structure, and conceptual sequencing.

### What belongs in a PR

✅ **Small maintenance only:**
- Typo corrections
- Broken links
- Formatting improvements
- Minor repository maintenance

### What does NOT belong in a PR

❌ **Content changes require an issue first:**
- New sections or topics
- Rewritten explanations
- Structural changes to existing content
- Conceptual additions or reorderings

---

## PR Checklist

- [ ] This PR fixes a typo, broken link, or formatting issue (no content changes)
- [ ] I have not changed any substantive explanation or added new content
- [ ] If unsure, I have opened an issue first and linked it below

---

**For content suggestions:** Please close this PR and open an issue using the appropriate template instead.

👉 [Open an Issue](https://github.com/DevMPoveaCL/software-engineering-playbook/issues/new/choose)
